leadText:
The Director is a character of the day who appeared in King and Queen for a Day!. Since he was not given an official name, he will be henceforth referred to as "the Director" within the context of this article.

The Director works on the television program King and Queen which features a playing the King, and a playing the Queen. He works with staff such as a Filmer and a Soundman. 's and James's were mistaken as the king and queen.
